title: MyFinder device pack loader 1-2
$comment: UTF-8 JSON, maximum 262144 bytes; reject duplicate object keys and non-JSON numeric constants before schema validation. Integers must be JSON integer tokens (not booleans or 1.0). Strings marked x-printable use Unicode Python str.isprintable semantics (exclude all Unicode Other/Separator categories except ASCII space). entries + disabled <= 2000. Structural errors, disallowed profile match fields and unsupported profileRev reject the whole pack. Semantic conflicts reject every affected row: duplicate VID/PID even across providers or disjoint interfaces, builtin/reserved VID/PID, unknown profile/provider, profile vendor/kind mismatch. native_atk rows (including disabled) are always rejected. Profile catalog and allowed match fields come from providers.profiles; only Razer additions in stage 2a. disabled supports the existing engine HID brand providers, never native/Bluetooth readers. Disabled targets override accepted entries and builtins. level defaults to C; source defaults to empty. Only the selected profile's battery reads are allowed; metadata cannot select another protocol. Signatures, key trust and rollback policy belong to the C# host. Loader 2 (published only as device-pack-v2-*.json; loader-1 hosts never fetch it) adds optional families: at most 64 objects marked x-family-spec, which hosts check only for being objects; the engine validates each with families.spec.parse_family and rejects a row on any spec error, a builtin family id, a duplicate id, or a device already claimed by a builtin reader, a builtin family, a pack entry or another pack family. families in a loader-1 document reject the whole pack.
